unpaged_port_research._honest_finding: AUDIT 2026-07-30 (operator challenge: 'did you do adequate research for them?'). ANSWER: NO — not at first pass. 2026-07-30.note: Deep research on the nine unpaged ports (the gap recorded in unpaged_port_research) returned corrections to facts already printed in this pack. All are now fixed in the .md.

corrections.now: Since 1625, when the Casa de Haver o Peso was established. The Provisão Régia of 21 March 1688, which most sources give as the founding, granted the Câmara de Belém the market's revenue 63 years later.

corrections.was: Ver-o-Peso runs to some two thousand stalls
corrections.now: The municipality counts 1,193 licensed traders (permissionários) and around 2,400 people working there daily.

corrections.was: Belém implied as an alongside call
corrections.now: Tender call anchoring off Icoaraci, about 18-20 km from the historic centre. The downtown quay carries little more than 7 m and cannot take Volendam's ~8.1 m draft. Volendam anchored off Icoaraci on 12 January 2026. A deep berth at Outeiro was built for COP30 but the port authority says low tide at cruise arrival and departure times keeps Icoaraci the more viable option.
corrections.source: Companhia Docas do Pará; observed 2026 call

corrections.now: Theatro da Paz was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List on 27 July 2026 as one of two components of the serial property 'Amazonia Theatres', with the Teatro Amazonas in Manaus. Criteria (ii)(iv), 48th session, Busan.
Ver-o-Peso was physically rebuilt for COP30 — fish market September 2025, main fair November 2025, meat market January 2026. Any description written before 2025 is obsolete.

Brazil reinstated visa requirements for US, Canadian and Australian citizens on 10 April 2025. e-Visa, about US$80.90, explicitly applies to arrival by vessel. Material on a heavily North American passenger list.
French Guiana is part of France and the EU but is NOT in the Schengen area; a Schengen visa does not admit a visa-national.

CNES has owned the Iles du Salut since 1971 (English Wikipedia says 1965). The islands are evacuated and closed for every eastward launch from Kourou under a prefectoral navigation ban, and the ban survives a postponement — a real cancellation mechanism distinct from swell.

As of 30 July 2026 Holland America had published no segment or partial-voyage options for the 2028 Grand World Voyage, though it did publish segments for 2027. Looks like a publication-timing gap rather than policy, but passengers cannot plan around 2028 segments today.
corrections.source: hollandamerica.com Grand Voyages landing page, checked 30 July 2026

corrections.was: yellow fever described only as a general 'consideration' for coastal West Africa
corrections.now: Côte d'Ivoire requires proof of yellow fever vaccination from ALL travellers aged 9 months and over regardless of origin — it is in the WHO IHR Annex 1 'any country' column, not the risk-country column. Certificates have been valid for life since 11 July 2016 and boosters cannot be demanded.

UNRESOLVED and flagged as such in the pack: the UK FCDO states a visa is required for Côte d'Ivoire, and the Ivorian e-visa is issued only for arrival at Abidjan airport and requires a return flight booking, making it structurally useless to a cruise passenger. Ships do land passengers, evidently under a ship-agent collective shore-pass arrangement, but no Ivorian government source documents a cruise exemption. Passengers must get HAL's answer in writing.
corrections.source: UK FCDO travel advice; SNEDAI e-visa portal

corrections.now: Abidjan is a berth inside a closed customs enclosure at a working grain terminal in Treichville. There is no cruise terminal — the port authority's own terminal list enumerates nine and none is for passengers. Port regulation prohibits free access to the quays and requires a pass from the Port Commander for any person or vehicle, so passengers cannot walk out.

Vridi Canal: 300 m wide, 18 m deep, no lock, no aerial obstruction; the harbourmaster's published limit is 15.5 m draft with no length limit (pre-2019 it was 260 m / 11.5 m). HAL's Zuiderdam at 286 m called on 26 March 2023.
'Ebrie' is an exonym meaning 'bad'. The correct usage for the lagoon people of Abidjan is Tchaman or Atchan.
Yamoussoukro and the Basilica of Our Lady of Peace are NOT feasible on a port day: 239 km from the berth, 6.5-8 hours of driving round trip, computed by routing rather than estimated.

US State Department advisory for Cote d'Ivoire is Level 2, reissued 18 February 2026; UK FCDO advice current at 30 July 2026, updated 29 May 2026. Neither restricts travel to Grand-Bassam. The widely repeated '50 km from the northern border' figure appears in neither: State names the Savanes and Zanzan districts with no km figure, and FCDO says 40 km.
corrections.source: US State Dept Consular Affairs API; UK FCDO
